C0493.title: Anhui Hefei Police Crack Province's First Facial Recognition Crime Case
C0493.summary: In 2021, Hefei police in Anhui dismantled a criminal gang that used AI to forge dynamic facial videos, arresting eight suspects. The group bypassed identity verification steps such as mobile SIM registration by simulating facial recognition technology, providing technical support to underground industrial chains. This was the first facial recognition crime case in Anhui Province.
